sd.description: SD card log. Append-only record stream consumed offline by the post-processor.

vcp.description: ST-Link USB virtual COM port. Primary live debug + console channel.

udp.description: Ethernet telemetry. Disabled until the lwIP stack is brought up.

vec3_f32.description: 3-component f32 vector. Used for positions, velocities, accelerations, biases — the meaning of the axes is left to the field that references this type.

quat_wxyz.description: Unit quaternion in (w, x, y, z) order, body-to-world rotation by convention.

system.description: Cross-cutting system services: logging, routing control, build identity, drop accounting.

log_event.description: Sporadic structured log entry. (source_module_id, event_code) together identify the event; description text is resolved on the host from this registry. NEVER carries free-form strings on the wire.

fields.name: event_code
fields.description: Module-local event identifier (typically an enum value defined in the source module's errors table).

fields.name: context
fields.description: Optional per-(source_module_id, event_code) structured payload. Codegen will gain a 'context_type' link on individual error entries once we agree on that extension.

drop_counter.description: Periodic snapshot of channel drop counts and SD-log writer health. Mandatory periodic so silent overruns and SD failures are never invisible.

fields.name: sd_drops
fields.description: Cumulative messages dropped at the sd channel since boot.

fields.name: vcp_drops
fields.description: Cumulative messages dropped at the vcp channel since boot.

fields.name: udp_drops
fields.description: Cumulative messages dropped at the udp channel since boot.

fields.name: cm7_ring_pushed
fields.description: Bytes successfully pushed onto the CM7→CM4 SRAM4 log handoff ring.

fields.name: cm7_ring_dropped
fields.description: Bytes dropped at the CM7→CM4 ring because it was full (producer back-pressure).

fields.name: sd_blocks_written
fields.description: Cumulative 512-byte blocks committed to the SD card since boot.

fields.name: sd_write_errors
fields.description: Cumulative SD write errors observed by sd_log_task; if >0 the writer is in degraded mode and discarding blocks.

set_route.description: Enable/disable a specific (msg_id, channel) routing. Rejected if routes are locked.

request.name: target_module_id
request.description: Module of the message whose routing is being changed.

fields.name: error_code
fields.description: Any system.* error code if ok=false, else 0.

lock_routes.description: Latch the current routing table. Subsequent set_route calls are rejected until reboot. Auto-fires when the mission manager arms.

get_build_info.description: Report firmware build identity. First thing the ground console asks after connecting so registry-version mismatches surface immediately.

fields.name: registry_version
fields.description: Registry format version this firmware was built against.

fields.name: registry_hash
fields.description: CRC32 of the registry.json that codegen ran over.

fields.name: build_flavor
fields.description: 0=debug 1=release. (git_sha as bytes deferred until nanopb max_size annotations land in the .proto emitter.)

routes_locked.description: set_route called after lock_routes — routing is frozen until reboot.

unknown_msg_id.description: set_route referenced a (module_id, msg_id) not present in this build's registry.

unknown_channel.description: set_route's channel_id was outside the registered channel set.

state_estimation.description: EKF outputs and intermediate state. CM4 produces these and routes to SD; CM7 controls consumes via the SRAM4 slot, not via this bus.

state_estimate.description: Current best estimate of vehicle state. The hot-path telemetry record.

fields.name: position
fields.description: ENU position relative to launch origin.

fields.name: gyro_bias
fields.description: Estimated gyro bias in body frame.

fields.name: accel_bias
fields.description: Estimated accel bias in body frame.

ekf_diverged.description: Innovation covariance non-positive-definite for >N consecutive updates; EKF was reinitialised from last-known-good.

no_imu_samples.description: State-estimation tick fired but the IMU ring was empty — driver may have stalled.

mag.description: MMC5983MA magnetometer. SET/RESET-differenced field samples plus the driver's live offset estimate.

sample.description: Per-SET/RESET-pair field sample. Offset is the driver's live (M_set + M_reset)/2 hard-iron estimate at the same sample instant; the EKF / state estimator uses (field - offset) as its measurement.

ring_overflow.description: Mag driver ring overflowed — the state estimation task drained too slowly. Field samples since the previous drain are lost.

spi_fault.description: SPI transfer to the MMC5983 failed in the service task. State machine reset to AWAIT_SET; next DRDY may re-establish the loop.

servo.description: Gimbal servo subsystem. Owns both X and Y servo channels behind one driver.

servo_status.description: Commanded gimbal angle vs. (when available) read-back angle for both axes. The gimbal servos (Dynamixel / Feetech) are position-commanded in degrees.

fields.name: readback_deg_x
fields.description: Servo present-position read-back, X axis (NaN if unavailable).

fields.name: readback_deg_y
fields.description: Servo present-position read-back, Y axis (NaN if unavailable).

fields.name: fault_flags
fields.description: Bitfield: bit0=X stall, bit1=Y stall, bit2=X over-temp, bit3=Y over-temp.

trigger_selftest.description: Run the on-board self-test. Streams progress messages until terminating with a result. Rejected when armed.

fields.name: ok
fields.description: Final result; only meaningful when phase=3.

fields.name: error_code
fields.description: servo.* error code if ok=false, else 0.

out_of_range.description: Self-test commanded angle outside calibrated mechanical limits.

cal_timeout.description: Self-test never observed read-back movement within the expected window.

armed_refused.description: trigger_selftest called while the mission manager is in an armed state.

imu.description: Inertial measurement units. ICM-40609 (primary) and BMI088 (secondary) calibrated samples as drained by the state-estimation task before EKF fusion. Logging both lets the estimator be replayed offline.

sample.description: Per-sample accel + gyro from one IMU. imu_id distinguishes the primary from the secondary so both streams share one message type.

ring_overflow.description: IMU driver ring overflowed — the state-estimation task drained too slowly; samples since the previous drain are lost.

baro.description: MS5611 barometer. Raw pressure + temperature samples as drained by the state-estimation task before the z update.

sample.description: Per-sample absolute pressure and compensated temperature.

ring_overflow.description: Baro driver ring overflowed before the state-estimation task drained it.

gps.description: NMEA GPS receiver. Raw fixes; on the bench with no antenna fix_type is typically 0 (no fix).

fix.description: Per-fix position, velocity and quality as parsed from NMEA.

ring_overflow.description: GPS driver ring overflowed before the state-estimation task drained it.
